lines.text: In T.T. STAR's waiting room.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Haa... haa...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hooooo...

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Hah...! Ha, haha...!

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Ahahaha!

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Ha, haha...!

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Heh...
Anis throws both hands up
and high-fives Mint and Prika.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: We did it! We actually did it!

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: ... Yeah, we did it.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: It still doesn't feel real.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So? How'd your first big stage feel?

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: It's freaking awesome!

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: So this is what it feels like.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: I'm still tingling all over, like I just got zapped.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Good, that's the state you should be in. Hold onto it. Take a short break, you're going back out soon.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Is it really fine to do it one song at a time like this?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Wouldn't it be better to just go straight through?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: What did you think was going to happen, working a bunch of rookies like that?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: The bigger the stage, the more careful you have to be.

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: You mentioned there'd be a guest performing while we take breaks, right?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Who is it? You haven't told us yet.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Yeah, you kept dodging it every time we asked.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: It's in your best interest.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: I don't get why you're making such a big secret out of it.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: It's Noise and Volume.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Why'd it have to be those two...?

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: At this rate, they're basically gonna overshadow us...

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: Oh... I guess we're not what they came for...

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: We've kept the guest performers under wraps.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Everyone out there came to see you, so relax.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Oh... okay.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: On your first big stage, you didn't slip once, and you kept your nerves in check.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: You delivered exactly what you rehearsed.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: ... What's with you all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I'm praising you. Don't make me repeat myself. You'd get halfway there even just by standing on stage.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: I don't know everything you went through back then,

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: but I know this: you clawed your way here and put up with whatever it took

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: because you wanted a chance like this.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Don't mistake this for luck.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: This is one of the results of everything you've done to get here.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Back then, you didn't have the means or the room to seize an opportunity like this. Now you do.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: So hold on to it with everything you have, and don't let go.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: ... Yeah, I will.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: Good. Now get ready.

lines.speaker: mrsmiss
lines.text: And don't get cocky just because you nailed one song.
Everyone gets to their feet,
exchanging quick glances before heading out.
On the way to the stage, Mint pokes Anis in the cheek.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Huh, what the...?

lines.speaker: mint_i
lines.text: C'mon, smile a little. You look like you're off to kill someone.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Man, I still can't smile naturally.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: You're good now.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: So don't hold back.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Just smile.

lines.speaker: anis_t
lines.text: Yeah, let's do it.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Let's call this off.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Even if it's already signed, we can still back out.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Huh? Wait, why?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Let's go. We're calling this off.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Uh... so, um...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Boss, I heard you're Mr. Mustang's son. Is that true?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I-I heard you two aren't really on good terms, and Mr. Mustang said he wants to make things right, so...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: we just thought maybe we could help somehow...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: get you two talking again...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Anis...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Thank you, I really do appreciate your concern.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I'll... I'll speak with my father and try to make things right.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: So, let's cancel this.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That should be all right, right?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: B-but why?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: I-I mean... if Tetra's backing us, we could...

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: seriously do way better... right?

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: It's Tetra, after all. They're basically the heart of the entertainment world, so we could really—

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No! Tetra's nothing like that!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: That place treats Nikkes as nothing more than products! You must not go there!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You'll be destroyed... completely ruined!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Th-this isn't the time. I'll go—I'll handle this myself...!

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I want to do this.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I want to keep going with Tetra's support.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: We've worked hard,

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: and I know we're not anything special.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: But... maybe that can change.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Maybe, even a little, we can become something more.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Maybe someday, we'll have our moment.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Maybe someone will finally notice us.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: That's why we've kept going all this time.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're doing better than you realize.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: It's just that your efforts haven't shone through yet. There's still plenty of time, so—

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Until when...?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: How long do we have to keep going like this?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: I-I'm not sure we'll ever really shine

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: since we're not... special.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: So does that mean...

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: people like us just have to keep crawling along, inch by inch... with nothing to guide us?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: We're supposed to believe there's something out there waiting for us when we can't even see it? Do we just keep feeling our way forward, blindly?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: This is a chance. If we have Tetra backing us,

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: then even ordinary people like us can become something special.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: You're wrong, Mint. You are special.

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: In what way...?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Wh-what exactly is so special about me? About us?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: If we really are, then why are we still stuck at the bottom like this?

lines.speaker: mint
lines.text: Is this what you call "special"?

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Mint...

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: I know what you're worried about, Boss.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: We know how tough it is for Tetra's pop stars.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: But we can do this. I'm sure of it.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: I don't think it's going to be that different, and we've done just fine so far.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: Struggling blindly won't get us anywhere.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: If we're going to struggle, I'd rather do it where there's at least a chance.

lines.speaker: prika
lines.text: That's what we do best, anyway.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: No... No...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-if I could just add... the training environment there is on a completely different level.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Tetra has professional trainers, top-tier facilities, and really strong support.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: And since they run their own broadcast channels, they can actively promote us if they want.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Just that alone would already make us...

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I see. So that's how you all feel.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I get where you're coming from,

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: but this time, I'll be making the decision.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: The deal is off.

lines.speaker: anis_human
lines.text: Boss.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Mustang and Tetra

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: aren't what you think they are!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: Even Pretty couldn't handle it. What makes you think you can?!

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: I-I'm really sorry. I wasn't trying to compare you. I truly wasn't.

lines.speaker: hanson
lines.text: B-but... no, this isn't right. I can't allow it.
Hanson straightens his clothes and heads for the door.
Just then, a voice from the TV cuts through the silence.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: It's been a while, hasn't it? Since we've seen any movement on the major charts.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: The major charts have been pretty stagnant for a while now.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Unless someone from the top messes up, it's almost impossible for smaller groups to break through.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: It's been a year and a half since the rankings last changed. That alone tells you how closed off the music scene is.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: So with Yoyo out, that opens up a spot?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Exactly, everyone's scrambling to claim that spot right now.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: What's interesting is that Tetra's starting to pay attention to the indie charts too.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Oh? How so?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Tetra has officially signed T.T. STAR, a small-time group that includes Anis, the victim of Yoyo's bullying.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Wait, they're supporting an indie group? That's a first, isn't it?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Yes, it's their first time.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Tetra's usual approach has been to let the smaller groups fight it out,

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: and only step in once one of them makes it big.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: But as I said, that hasn't happened in a year and a half.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Some see it as a way of supporting a bullying victim.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Yeah. Honestly, with so many groups out there that are both more skilled and have more potential than T.T. STAR, it's not exactly an allegation they can shake off.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Hmm... the smaller groups probably won't just sit back and let this happen.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: They will. No one's stupid enough to pick a fight with Tetra.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Haha, fair enough.

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: If anything, most people are probably thinking, "Wait, could that be us too?"

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Oh? So Tetra's setting a precedent by pulling someone up from the indie scene?

lines.speaker: femaleannouncer
lines.text: Yes. With Tetra backing them, this is basically a declaration that they're pushing the group straight into the mainstream.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Well, that's interesting.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: Guess we'll see what Tetra's decision does to the pop star scene.

lines.speaker: maleannouncer
lines.text: All right, let's move on to the next story.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: They've already... made the announcement. That was fast.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: W-we've... moved up to 11th.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: A-all they did was announce it, and... we jumped two spots.
Hanson yanks the door open and storms out.
